summary: Plaintiffs raised fees in their initial term sheets, before class relief was settled. The transcript expressly links fee allocation to class recovery when Whitcombe Reyes proposes shifting the same total outlay toward the class. There is no clear evidence that class counsel prioritized its own compensation; compensation was fixed and Whitcombe reduced the fee line. Defense accepted the lowest total proposal among overlapping class counsel, supporting the reverse-auction-tactics label.
